note: P2 conservative variant (2026-08-24), refined by the bend-angle x width mini-experiment. EVALUATED but NOT ADOPTED as production — the corner-concentration threshold rests on 18 synthetic V-bend combos + 2 real sharp-corner cells; a wider angle/position sweep (and intersection-corner real cells) is recommended before adoption.

sharp_corner_zero.comment: discrete zero when max_turn_deg >= 20 AND cum_turn_deg >= 20 AND max_turn/cum_turn >= 0.6 (a CONCENTRATED single corner, not a gradual curve)

rules.q_max_extra_wide_comment: W > 3.0 m -> cap q_max at 15 (synthetic q_max=20 was only validated to W=3.0)

bend_sweep_finding.grid: theta {0,30,45,60,75,90} deg x W {2.0,2.5,3.0} m x qp=50 x 30 seeds = 18 combos
bend_sweep_finding.key_insight: a SINGLE sharp corner (V-bend) collapses robot throughput even at 30 deg (qr* 8-10 -> 0-2) at ALL widths; the operative feature is turn CONCENTRATION (max_turn/cum_turn ~1 for a corner vs <=0.5 for a gradual curve), which sinuosity cannot capture (30 deg corner has sinuosity only 1.035).
bend_sweep_finding.baseline_vbar: corner already slows pedestrians: vbar 1.198 (0deg) -> 0.931 (30deg) -> 0.623 (90deg) at W=2.5
